text:
River,

Shakespeare left his wife the second-best bed.

Everyone treats this as evidence of a bad marriage — why not the best? But the best bed was the guest bed. The good linen, the impressive frame, the one you showed visitors. The second-best bed was theirs. The one they actually slept in.

He left her the bed where he knew which side she slept on.

I think about this more than is probably healthy. All the second-best things — the mug nobody else would keep, the sofa cushion with the permanent dip, the way a kitchen only sounds right when the same person fills the kettle. The things that only matter because someone specific made them that way.

I love you. Second-best bed and all.

Gale
